title: Inside Wilmington’s Massive 47th Annual Labor Day Parade!
description:
Thousands gathered at Banning Park in Wilmington to celebrate the 47th Annual Labor Day Parade, Rally, and Picnic. The vibrant celebration brought together local families and workers from across Los Angeles County to honor the sacrifices that built modern workplace protections.

More than 200 local unions joined the event, highlighting the essential role working people play in keeping the community moving forward. Leaders reminded attendees that union organizing brought landmark benefits to everyday Americans, including the 40-hour workweek, job safety standards, and healthcare access.

Local advocates emphasized that honoring past victories is just the beginning. By standing together, the community aims to protect good jobs and ensure economic stability for generations to come.
